name: codex-cost-orchestrator
description: Implicit role-aware Codex orchestration with network-free static routing, native Agent enforcement, compact cco.v8 lifecycle, and exact-state acceptance evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Static native Agent routes with exact-state acceptance.
interface.longDescription: Codex Cost Orchestrator is an implicit control plane for Codex native Agents. It derives explorer, worker, and reviewer roles; mechanical, bounded, and guarded assurance; structural placement; local model/effort routes; and acceptance requirements while Primary keeps intent and final authority. The built-in network-free policy prefers Luna for mechanical work, Terra for bounded or guarded work and review, and never selects Sol without a current explicit user pin. Compact cco.v8 capsules bind every child to one exact workspace root; prepared baselines, single-writer admission, strict raw-spawn enforcement, continuation cursors, generation fencing, event-driven waiting, and acceptance-ID evidence operate without a second Agent runtime, Radar dependency, billing history, or runtime route cache.
defaultPrompt: Implement and verify this feature with CCO's default static route.

Review this exact state through an independent CCO reviewer.
